ko.title: 깊은 타격, 얕은 대화: 트럼프의 앙카라 젤렌스키 회담이 모스크바를 움직이지 못한 이유

segments.src: ## A Symbolic Handshake, Not a Breakthrough
segments.tr: ## 돌파구가 아닌 상징적 악수

segments.src: On the sidelines of the latest NATO summit in Ankara, President Donald Trump sat down with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky for a meeting that generated headlines but, according to officials briefed on the talks, little in the way of new terms.
segments.tr: 앙카라에서 열린 최근 나토(NATO) 정상회의 부대 행사에서, 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 볼로디미르 젤렌스키 우크라이나 대통령과 마주 앉아 회담을 가졌습니다. 이 회담은 헤드라인을 장식했지만, 회담 내용을 전해 들은 관료들에 따르면 새로운 조건 측면에서는 거의 진전이 없었습니다.

segments.src: Trump reportedly framed Ukraine's long-range strikes deep into Russian territory as a source of genuine battlefield leverage, suggesting that pressure on Russian infrastructure and logistics could eventually push Moscow toward the negotiating table on terms more favorable to Kyiv.
segments.tr: 보도에 따르면 트럼프는 러시아 영토 깊숙한 곳에 대한 우크라이나의 장거리 타격을 진정한 전장 레버리지의 원천으로 규정하며, 러시아의 인프라와 군수지원에 대한 압박이 결국 모스크바를 키이우에 더 유리한 조건의 협상 테이블로 이끌 수 있음을 시사했습니다.

segments.src: It was a notable shift in tone from a president who has spent much of the past year urging both sides toward a rapid ceasefire.
segments.tr: 이는 지난 한 해 동안 양측에 신속한 휴전을 촉구해 온 대통령의 태도에서 주목할 만한 변화였습니다.

segments.src: Yet according to diplomats familiar with the discussions, the meeting produced encouragement rather than a concrete framework — and the core dispute that has sunk every previous attempt at a truce remains untouched.
segments.tr: 그러나 논의에 밝은 외교관들에 따르면, 이번 회담은 구체적인 틀보다는 고무적인 분위기를 낳았으며, 이전의 모든 휴전 시도를 무산시켰던 핵심 쟁점은 여전히 해결되지 않은 채 남아 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Sticking Point Hasn't Changed
segments.tr: ## 변하지 않은 쟁점

segments.src: That dispute is the status of the Donbas.
segments.tr: 그 쟁점은 바로 돈바스의 지위입니다.

segments.src: Russian negotiators have consistently signaled that any lasting settlement requires Ukraine to formally cede the remaining Ukrainian-held portions of Donetsk and Luhansk, territory Moscow already claims as annexed but does not fully control militarily.
segments.tr: 러시아 협상단은 지속 가능한 합의를 위해서는 우크라이나가 도네츠크와 루한스크의 남은 우크라이나 통제 지역을 공식적으로 할양해야 한다는 입장을 일관되게 시사해 왔습니다. 이 지역은 모스크바가 이미 병합을 주장하고 있으나 군사적으로는 완전히 통제하지 못하는 곳입니다.

segments.src: Kyiv has just as consistently rejected that demand, arguing that surrendering unoccupied, fortified territory — including cities Ukrainian forces have defended for years — would be both a constitutional and strategic red line.
segments.tr: 키이우는 점령당하지 않은 요충지(우크라이나 군대가 수년간 방어해 온 도시들 포함)를 양보하는 것은 헌법적 및 전략적 레드라인이 될 것이라고 주장하며 이러한 요구를 그토록 일관되게 거부해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: 회담을 추적해 온 분석가들은 이것이 2026년에 부상한 유럽 중재안부터 걸프 지역 중재인들이 개입한 비공식 채널에 이르기까지 거의 모든 휴전 프레임워크를 좌초시킨 단층선이라고 말합니다.

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.
segments.tr: 장거리 타격이 아무리 극적이라 하더라도 이러한 기본적인 등식은 바꾸지 못했습니다.

segments.src: "Battlefield pressure can change the pace of talks," one Europe-based security analyst said.
segments.tr: "전장 압박은 협상의 속도를 바꿀 수 있습니다,"라고 한 유럽 소재 안보 분석가는 말했습니다.

segments.src: "It hasn't changed the substance of what each side says it needs to walk away with."
segments.tr: "하지만 각 측이 협상장을 떠나기 위해 필요하다고 말하는 것의 본질은 바꾸지 못했습니다."

segments.src: ## Why Strikes Alone Don't Translate Into Leverage
segments.tr: ## 타격만으로는 레버리지로 이어지지 않는 이유

segments.src: Ukraine's expanded use of long-range drones and missiles against refineries, depots, and logistics hubs inside Russia has undeniably raised costs for Moscow and disrupted parts of its energy sector.
segments.tr: 러시아 내 정유소, 저장고, 물류 허브를 겨냥한 우크라이나의 장거리 드론 및 미사일 사용 확대는 모스크바의 비용을 부인할 수 없이 높였으며 에너지 부문의 일부를 교란했습니다.

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: 앙카라에서의 트럼프 발언은 러시아 영토 깊숙한 곳에 대한 타 자제력을 촉구했던 백악관의 이전 메시지에서 주목할 만한 탈피로서, 그러한 캠페인을 억제해야 할 에스컬레이션이 아니라 정당한 협상 도구로 지지하는 것으로 보였습니다.

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: 그러나 우크라이나와 러시아 양측의 관료들은 이번 변화에 너무 큰 의미를 부여하는 것에 대해 경고하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Russian state media and officials have downplayed the summit meeting, characterizing the strikes as attacks that stiffen domestic resolve rather than weaken negotiating positions.
segments.tr: 러시아 국영 매체와 관료들은 이번 정상회의를 평가절하하며, 이번 타격이 협상력을 약화시키기보다는 오히려 국내의 결속을 다지는 공격이라고 규정했습니다.

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.
segments.tr: 크렘린궁 대변인들은 영토 문제란 전장의 모멘텀에 따라 좌우되는 양보안이 아니라 "협상 불가능한 출발점"임을 거듭 강조했습니다.

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.
segments.tr: 한편 우크라이나 관료들은 트럼프의 수사적 지지를 환영했으나 그것이 실제로 무엇을 의미하는지 과장하지 않기 위해 조심스러워했습니다.

segments.src: Kyiv continues to seek firmer security guarantees — potential NATO-adjacent commitments or bilateral defense pacts — as a condition for any territorial compromise, a demand that has so far found no consensus among allies either.
segments.tr: 키이우는 어떠한 영토 타협의 조건으로 더 확고한 안보 보장(나토 인접 성약 또는 양자 간 방위 조약)을 계속 추구하고 있으며, 이는 지금까지 동맹국들 사이에서도 합의를 찾지 못한 요구입니다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 앞으로의 전망

segments.src: For now, the Ankara meeting appears to function more as a signal of alignment between Washington and Kyiv than as the start of a new negotiating track.
segments.tr: 현재로서는 앙카라 회담이 새로운 협상 트랙의 시작이라기보다는 워싱턴과 키이우 간의 공조 신호로서 더 기능하는 것으로 보입니다.

segments.src: Diplomats say follow-up talks are likely in the coming weeks, possibly involving European and Turkish intermediaries who have hosted previous rounds of indirect contact between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
segments.tr: 외교관들은 러시아와 우크라이나 대표단 간의 이전 간접 접촉 라운드를 주최했던 유럽과 터키의 중재자들이 참여할 가능성이 높은 후속 회담이 다가오는 주에 열릴 것이라고 말합니다.

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: 돈바스 문제가 정면으로 다루어질 때까지 — 양국 정부가 국내에서 방어 가능하다고 제시할 수 있는 모색안을 통해 — 관료들과 분석가들은 앙카라에서와 같은 고위급 외교적 순간조차도 한 해 동안 협상가들을 비켜간 지속 가능한 휴전 프레임워크를 도출하지 못한 채 헤드라인만 장식할 가능성이 높다는 데 전적으로 동의합니다.

zh.title: 深度打击与浅层对话：为什么特朗普在安卡拉与泽连斯基的会晤未能触动莫斯科

segments.src: ## A Symbolic Handshake, Not a Breakthrough
segments.tr: ## 一场象征性的握手，而非突破

segments.src: On the sidelines of the latest NATO summit in Ankara, President Donald Trump sat down with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky for a meeting that generated headlines but, according to officials briefed on the talks, little in the way of new terms.
segments.tr: 在安卡拉最新北约峰会的场边，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基举行了一场引发头条新闻的会晤，但据简报官员透露，双方在达成新条款方面几无进展。

segments.src: Trump reportedly framed Ukraine's long-range strikes deep into Russian territory as a source of genuine battlefield leverage, suggesting that pressure on Russian infrastructure and logistics could eventually push Moscow toward the negotiating table on terms more favorable to Kyiv.
segments.tr: 据报道，特朗普将乌克兰对俄罗斯领土纵深的远程打击框定为真正的战场筹码来源，并暗示对俄罗斯基础设施和后勤的压力最终可能促使莫斯科走向更有利于基辅的谈判桌。

segments.src: It was a notable shift in tone from a president who has spent much of the past year urging both sides toward a rapid ceasefire.
segments.tr: 对于一位在过去一年里大部时间都在敦促双方迅速实现停火的总统来说，这是一个显着的语气转变。

segments.src: Yet according to diplomats familiar with the discussions, the meeting produced encouragement rather than a concrete framework — and the core dispute that has sunk every previous attempt at a truce remains untouched.
segments.tr: 然而，据熟悉讨论的外交官称，这次会晤产生的是鼓励而非具体的框架——并且彻底粉碎了以往每一次停火尝试的核心争议依然原封不动。

segments.src: ## The Sticking Point Hasn't Changed
segments.tr: ## 症结并未改变

segments.src: That dispute is the status of the Donbas.
segments.tr: 这个争议就是顿巴斯的地位。

segments.src: Russian negotiators have consistently signaled that any lasting settlement requires Ukraine to formally cede the remaining Ukrainian-held portions of Donetsk and Luhansk, territory Moscow already claims as annexed but does not fully control militarily.
segments.tr: 俄罗斯谈判代表一贯表示，任何持久的解决方案都要求乌克兰正式割让顿涅茨克和卢甘斯克目前仍由乌克兰控制的部分，莫斯科已经声称吞并了这些领土，但在军事上并未完全控制。

segments.src: Kyiv has just as consistently rejected that demand, arguing that surrendering unoccupied, fortified territory — including cities Ukrainian forces have defended for years — would be both a constitutional and strategic red line.
segments.tr: 基辅同样一贯拒绝这一要求，并认为放弃未被占领的、经过筑垒的领土——包括乌克兰军队多年来一直防守的城市——既是宪法红线，也是战略红线。

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: 跟踪这些会谈的分析人士表示，这是导致2026年浮出水面的几乎所有停火框架（从欧洲斡旋的提议到涉及海湾调解员的非正式渠道）触礁的断层线。

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.
segments.tr: 远程打击无论多么引人注目，也未能改变这一基本等式。

segments.src: "Battlefield pressure can change the pace of talks," one Europe-based security analyst said.
segments.tr: "战场压力可以改变谈判的节奏，"一位驻欧洲的安全分析人士说。

segments.src: "It hasn't changed the substance of what each side says it needs to walk away with."
segments.tr: "它并没有改变每一方声称自己需要带着什么离开的实质内容。"

segments.src: ## Why Strikes Alone Don't Translate Into Leverage
segments.tr: ## 为什么单纯的打击无法转化为筹码

segments.src: Ukraine's expanded use of long-range drones and missiles against refineries, depots, and logistics hubs inside Russia has undeniably raised costs for Moscow and disrupted parts of its energy sector.
segments.tr: 乌克兰在俄罗斯境内对炼油厂、仓库和后勤枢纽扩大使用远程无人机和导弹，无疑增加了莫斯科的成本，并扰乱了其部分能源部门。

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: 特朗普在安卡拉的言论似乎认可了这一行动是一种合法的讨价还价工具，而不是一种应予阻止的升级——这与白宫早先敦促克制深入俄罗斯领土打击的信息形成了显著的背离。

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: 然而，乌克兰和俄罗斯双方的官员都警告不要对这种转变进行过分解读。

segments.src: Russian state media and officials have downplayed the summit meeting, characterizing the strikes as attacks that stiffen domestic resolve rather than weaken negotiating positions.
segments.tr: 俄罗斯官方媒体和官员淡化了此次峰会，将这些打击定性为巩固国内决心而非削弱谈判立场的袭击。

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.
segments.tr: 克里姆林宫发言人重申，领土问题是“不可谈判的出发点”，而不是受战场势头影响的开盘报价。

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.
segments.tr: 与此同时，乌克兰官员对特朗普的修辞支持表示欢迎，但一直小心翼翼地不夸大其实际意义。

segments.src: Kyiv continues to seek firmer security guarantees — potential NATO-adjacent commitments or bilateral defense pacts — as a condition for any territorial compromise, a demand that has so far found no consensus among allies either.
segments.tr: 基辅继续寻求更坚定的安全保障——潜在的准北约承诺或双边防务条约——作为任何领土妥协的条件，这一要求迄今为止在盟友中也没有达成共识。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: For now, the Ankara meeting appears to function more as a signal of alignment between Washington and Kyiv than as the start of a new negotiating track.
segments.tr: 就目前而言，安卡拉会晤似乎更多地起到华盛顿与基辅之间协调一致的信号作用，而不是新谈判轨道的开始。

segments.src: Diplomats say follow-up talks are likely in the coming weeks, possibly involving European and Turkish intermediaries who have hosted previous rounds of indirect contact between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
segments.tr: 外交官们表示，未来几周可能会进行后续会谈，可能涉及曾主办过俄乌代表团之间前几轮间接接触的欧洲和土耳其调解人。

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: 在顿巴斯问题得到正面解决之前——通过两国政府都可以在国内辩护的某种公式——官员和分析人士普遍认为，即使是像安卡拉那样备受瞩目的外交时刻，也可能只产生头条新闻，而无法产生贯穿全年的让谈判人员失之交臂的那种持久停火框架。

segments.src: ## A Symbolic Handshake, Not a Breakthrough
segments.tr: ## एक प्रतीकात्मक हाथ मिलाना, कोई बड़ी सफलता नहीं

segments.src: On the sidelines of the latest NATO summit in Ankara, President Donald Trump sat down with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky for a meeting that generated headlines but, according to officials briefed on the talks, little in the way of new terms.
segments.tr: अंकारा में नवीनतम नाटो शिखर सम्मेलन के दौरान, राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प ने यूक्रेनी राष्ट्रपति वोलोडिमिर ज़ेलेंस्की के साथ एक बैठक की, जिसने सुर्खियाँ तो बटोरीं लेकिन, बातचीत के बारे में जानकारी रखने वाले अधिकारियों के अनुसार, नई शर्तों के मामले में बहुत कम परिणाम दिए।

segments.src: Trump reportedly framed Ukraine's long-range strikes deep into Russian territory as a source of genuine battlefield leverage, suggesting that pressure on Russian infrastructure and logistics could eventually push Moscow toward the negotiating table on terms more favorable to Kyiv.
segments.tr: खबरों के अनुसार, ट्रम्प ने रूसी क्षेत्र में गहराई तक यूक्रेन के लंबी दूरी के प्रहारों को वास्तविक युद्धक्षेत्र लाभ के स्रोत के रूप में पेश किया, यह सुझाव देते हुए कि रूसी बुनियादी ढांचे और रसद पर दबाव डालने से अंततः मॉस्को को उन शर्तों पर बातचीत की मेज पर लाया जा सकता है जो कीव के लिए अधिक अनुकूल हों।

segments.src: It was a notable shift in tone from a president who has spent much of the past year urging both sides toward a rapid ceasefire.
segments.tr: यह उस राष्ट्रपति की ओर से लहजे में एक उल्लेखनीय बदलाव था, जिन्होंने पिछले साल का अधिकांश समय दोनों पक्षों को तेजी से युद्धविराम के लिए प्रेरित करने में बिताया था।

segments.src: Yet according to diplomats familiar with the discussions, the meeting produced encouragement rather than a concrete framework — and the core dispute that has sunk every previous attempt at a truce remains untouched.
segments.tr: फिर भी, चर्चाओं से परिचित राजनयिकों के अनुसार, बैठक से प्रोत्साहन मिला, न कि कोई ठोस ढांचा — और वह मुख्य विवाद जो पिछले हर युद्धविराम के प्रयास को विफल कर चुका है, वह अभी भी अनसुलझा है।

segments.src: ## The Sticking Point Hasn't Changed
segments.tr: ## मुख्य विवाद बिंदु नहीं बदला है

segments.src: That dispute is the status of the Donbas.
segments.tr: वह विवाद डोनबास की स्थिति का है।

segments.src: Russian negotiators have consistently signaled that any lasting settlement requires Ukraine to formally cede the remaining Ukrainian-held portions of Donetsk and Luhansk, territory Moscow already claims as annexed but does not fully control militarily.
segments.tr: रूसी वार्ताकारों ने लगातार संकेत दिया है कि किसी भी स्थायी समाधान के लिए यूक्रेन को औपचारिक रूप से डोनेट्स्क और लुहान्स्क के शेष यूक्रेनी-नियंत्रित हिस्सों को छोड़ना होगा, वह क्षेत्र जिसे मॉस्को पहले ही अनुलग्न किया हुआ दावा करता है लेकिन सैन्य रूप से पूरी तरह से नियंत्रित नहीं करता है।

segments.src: Kyiv has just as consistently rejected that demand, arguing that surrendering unoccupied, fortified territory — including cities Ukrainian forces have defended for years — would be both a constitutional and strategic red line.
segments.tr: कीव ने भी उतनी ही निरंतरता के साथ उस मांग को खारिज कर दिया है, यह तर्क देते हुए कि अनकब्जे वाले, किलेबंद क्षेत्र — जिनमें वे शहर शामिल हैं जिनकी यूक्रेनी सेनाओं ने वर्षों तक रक्षा की है — को समर्पित करना संवैधानिक और रणनीतिक दोनों ही लाल रेखाएं होंगी।

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: बातचीत पर नज़र रखने वाले विश्लेषकों का कहना है कि यह वह दरार है जिसने 2026 में पेश किए गए लगभग हर युद्धविराम ढांचे को विफल कर दिया है, यूरोपीय-मध्यस्थता वाले प्रस्तावों से लेकर खाड़ी मध्यस्थों से जुड़े अनौपचारिक चैनलों तक।

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.
segments.tr: लंबी दूरी के प्रहार, चाहे कितने भी नाटकीय हों, उस बुनियादी समीकरण को नहीं बदल पाए हैं।

segments.src: "Battlefield pressure can change the pace of talks," one Europe-based security analyst said.
segments.tr: "युद्धक्षेत्र का दबाव बातचीत की गति को बदल सकता है," एक यूरोप-आधारित सुरक्षा विश्लेषक ने कहा।

segments.src: "It hasn't changed the substance of what each side says it needs to walk away with."
segments.tr: "लेकिन इसने उस पदार्थ को नहीं बदला है जिसे प्रत्येक पक्ष कहता है कि उसे लेकर वापस जाना है।"

segments.src: ## Why Strikes Alone Don't Translate Into Leverage
segments.tr: ## केवल प्रहार लाभ में क्यों नहीं बदलते

segments.src: Ukraine's expanded use of long-range drones and missiles against refineries, depots, and logistics hubs inside Russia has undeniably raised costs for Moscow and disrupted parts of its energy sector.
segments.tr: रूस के भीतर रिफाइनरियों, डिपो और रसद केंद्रों के खिलाफ यूक्रेन द्वारा लंबी दूरी के ड्रोन और मिसाइलों के विस्तारित उपयोग ने निस्संदेह मॉस्को के लिए लागत बढ़ाई है और उसके ऊर्जा क्षेत्र के कुछ हिस्सों को बाधित किया है।

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: अंकारा में ट्रम्प की टिप्पणियों ने उस अभियान को हतोत्साहित करने वाले तनाव के बजाय एक वैध सौदेबाजी के उपकरण के रूप में समर्थन दिया प्रतीत होता है — यह व्हाइट हाउस के पिछले संदेशों से एक उल्लेखनीय बदलाव है, जिन्होंने रूसी क्षेत्र के भीतर गहराई तक प्रहारों पर संयम बरतने का आग्रह किया था।

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: लेकिन यूक्रेनी और रूसी दोनों पक्षों के अधिकारी इस बदलाव को बहुत अधिक महत्व देने के प्रति सचेत करते हैं।

segments.src: Russian state media and officials have downplayed the summit meeting, characterizing the strikes as attacks that stiffen domestic resolve rather than weaken negotiating positions.
segments.tr: रूसी राज्य मीडिया और अधिकारियों ने शिखर सम्मेलन की बैठक को कम करके दिखाया है, प्रहारों को ऐसे हमलों के रूप में चित्रित किया है जो बातचीत की स्थिति को कमजोर करने के बजाय घरेलू संकल्प को और मजबूत करते हैं।

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.
segments.tr: क्रेमलिन के प्रवक्ताओं ने दोहराया है कि क्षेत्रीय प्रश्न "गैर-परक्राम्य शुरुआती बिंदु" हैं, न कि युद्धक्षेत्र की गति पर आधारित शुरुआती बोलियां।

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.
segments.tr: इस बीच, यूक्रेनी अधिकारियों ने ट्रम्प के बयानबाजी के समर्थन का स्वागत किया है लेकिन वे इस बात पर जोर देने से बचते रहे हैं कि व्यवहार में इसका क्या मतलब है।

segments.src: Kyiv continues to seek firmer security guarantees — potential NATO-adjacent commitments or bilateral defense pacts — as a condition for any territorial compromise, a demand that has so far found no consensus among allies either.
segments.tr: कीव किसी भी क्षेत्रीय समझौते के लिए एक शर्त के रूप में अधिक ठोस सुरक्षा गारंटी — संभावित नाटो-संबद्ध प्रतिबद्धताओं या द्विपक्षीय रक्षा समझौतों — की तलाश करना जारी रखता है, एक ऐसी मांग जिसे अब तक सहयोगियों के बीच भी कोई सहमति नहीं मिली है।

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होगा

segments.src: For now, the Ankara meeting appears to function more as a signal of alignment between Washington and Kyiv than as the start of a new negotiating track.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, अंकारा बैठक वाशिंगटन और कीव के बीच संरेखण के संकेत के रूप में अधिक कार्य करती है, न कि एक नए बातचीत के ट्रैक के रूप में।

segments.src: Diplomats say follow-up talks are likely in the coming weeks, possibly involving European and Turkish intermediaries who have hosted previous rounds of indirect contact between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
segments.tr: राजनयिकों का कहना है कि आने वाले हफ्तों में अनुवर्ती बातचीत होने की संभावना है, जिसमें संभवतः यूरोपीय और तुर्की मध्यस्थ शामिल होंगे जिन्होंने रूसी और यूक्रेनी प्रतिनिधिमंडलों के बीच पिछले दौर की अप्रत्यक्ष बातचीत की मेजबानी की है।

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: जब तक डोनबास प्रश्न का सीधे तौर पर समाधान नहीं किया जाता — किसी ऐसे सूत्र के माध्यम से जिसे दोनों सरकारें अपने देश में बचाव योग्य बता सकें — अधिकारियों और विश्लेषकों का व्यापक रूप से यह मानना है कि अंकारा जैसी उच्च-प्रोफ़ाइल राजनयिक क्षण भी केवल सुर्खियाँ बटोरेंगे, बिना उस टिकाऊ युद्धविराम ढांचे को उत्पन्न किए जो पूरे वर्ष वार्ताकारों के लिए मायावी रहा है।

es.title: Golpes profundos, conversaciones superficiales: Por qué la reunión de Trump con Zelensky en Ankara no ha conmovido a Moscú

segments.src: ## A Symbolic Handshake, Not a Breakthrough
segments.tr: ## Un apretón de manos simbólico, no un avance

segments.src: On the sidelines of the latest NATO summit in Ankara, President Donald Trump sat down with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky for a meeting that generated headlines but, according to officials briefed on the talks, little in the way of new terms.
segments.tr: Al margen de la última cumbre de la OTAN en Ankara, el presidente Donald Trump se reunió con el presidente ucraniano Volodymyr Zelensky en un encuentro que generó titulares, pero que, según funcionarios informados sobre las conversaciones, aportó muy poco en términos de nuevos acuerdos.

segments.src: Trump reportedly framed Ukraine's long-range strikes deep into Russian territory as a source of genuine battlefield leverage, suggesting that pressure on Russian infrastructure and logistics could eventually push Moscow toward the negotiating table on terms more favorable to Kyiv.
segments.tr: Según se informa, Trump planteó los ataques de largo alcance de Ucrania en territorio ruso como una fuente de ventaja real en el campo de batalla, sugiriendo que la presión sobre la infraestructura y la logística rusa podría eventualmente empujar a Moscú a la mesa de negociaciones en términos más favorables para Kiev.

segments.src: It was a notable shift in tone from a president who has spent much of the past year urging both sides toward a rapid ceasefire.
segments.tr: Fue un cambio notable de tono por parte de un presidente que ha pasado gran parte del último año instando a ambas partes a un alto el fuego rápido.

segments.src: Yet according to diplomats familiar with the discussions, the meeting produced encouragement rather than a concrete framework — and the core dispute that has sunk every previous attempt at a truce remains untouched.
segments.tr: Sin embargo, según diplomáticos familiarizados con las discusiones, la reunión produjo aliento en lugar de un marco concreto, y la disputa central que ha hundido cada intento previo de tregua permanece intacta.

segments.src: ## The Sticking Point Hasn't Changed
segments.tr: ## El punto crítico no ha cambiado

segments.src: That dispute is the status of the Donbas.
segments.tr: Esa disputa es el estatus del Donbás.

segments.src: Russian negotiators have consistently signaled that any lasting settlement requires Ukraine to formally cede the remaining Ukrainian-held portions of Donetsk and Luhansk, territory Moscow already claims as annexed but does not fully control militarily.
segments.tr: Los negociadores rusos han señalado consistentemente que cualquier acuerdo duradero requiere que Ucrania ceda formalmente las partes restantes del Donetsk y Luhansk bajo control ucraniano, territorio que Moscú ya reclama como anexionado pero que no controla totalmente desde el punto de vista militar.

segments.src: Kyiv has just as consistently rejected that demand, arguing that surrendering unoccupied, fortified territory — including cities Ukrainian forces have defended for years — would be both a constitutional and strategic red line.
segments.tr: Kiev ha rechazado ese demand con la misma consistencia, argumentando que rendir territorio fortificado y no ocupado —incluidas ciudades que las fuerzas ucranianas han defendido durante años— sería una línea roja tanto constitucional como estratégica.

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: Los analistas que siguen las conversaciones dicen que esta es la falla que ha zozobrado casi todos los marcos de alto el fuego propuestos en 2026, desde propuestas mediadas por Europa hasta canales informales que involucran a mediadores del Golfo.

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.
segments.tr: Los ataques de largo alcance, por muy dramáticos que sean, no han alterado esa ecuación básica.

segments.src: "Battlefield pressure can change the pace of talks," one Europe-based security analyst said.
segments.tr: "La presión en el campo de batalla puede cambiar el ritmo de las conversaciones", dijo un analista de seguridad basado en Europa.

segments.src: "It hasn't changed the substance of what each side says it needs to walk away with."
segments.tr: "Pero no ha cambiado la sustancia de lo que cada lado dice que necesita obtener para retirarse".

segments.src: ## Why Strikes Alone Don't Translate Into Leverage
segments.tr: ## Por qué los ataques por sí solos no se traducen en ventaja

segments.src: Ukraine's expanded use of long-range drones and missiles against refineries, depots, and logistics hubs inside Russia has undeniably raised costs for Moscow and disrupted parts of its energy sector.
segments.tr: El uso ampliado de drones y misiles de largo alcance por parte de Ucrania contra refinerías, depósitos y centros logísticos dentro de Rusia ha aumentado innegablemente los costos para Moscú y ha perturbado partes de su sector energético.

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: Los comentarios de Trump en Ankara parecieron respaldar esa campaña como una herramienta de negociación legítima en lugar de una escalada que deba desalentarse, una desviación notable de los mensajes anteriores de la Casa Blanca que habían instado a la moderación en los ataques profundos en territorio ruso.

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: Pero los funcionarios de ambos bandos, ucraniano y ruso, advierten que no se lea demasiado en este cambio.

segments.src: Russian state media and officials have downplayed the summit meeting, characterizing the strikes as attacks that stiffen domestic resolve rather than weaken negotiating positions.
segments.tr: Los medios estatales rusos y los funcionarios han minimizado la reunión de la cumbre, caracterizando los ataques como agresiones que endurecen la resolución interna en lugar de debilitar las posiciones de negociación.

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.
segments.tr: Los portavoces del Kremlin han reiterado que las cuestiones territoriales son "puntos de partida no negociables", no ofertas iniciales sujetas al impulso del campo de batalla.

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.
segments.tr: Mientras tanto, los funcionarios ucranianos han acogido con satisfacción el apoyo retórico de Trump, pero han sido cuidadosos de no exagerar lo que esto significa en la práctica.

segments.src: Kyiv continues to seek firmer security guarantees — potential NATO-adjacent commitments or bilateral defense pacts — as a condition for any territorial compromise, a demand that has so far found no consensus among allies either.
segments.tr: Kiev sigue buscando garantías de seguridad más firmes —posibles compromisos adyacentes a la OTAN o pactos de defensa bilaterales— como condición para cualquier compromiso territorial, una demanda que hasta ahora no ha encontrado consenso entre los aliados tampoco.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Qué sigue

segments.src: For now, the Ankara meeting appears to function more as a signal of alignment between Washington and Kyiv than as the start of a new negotiating track.
segments.tr: Por ahora, la reunión de Ankara parece funcionar más como una señal de alineación entre Washington y Kiev que como el inicio de una nueva vía de negociación.

segments.src: Diplomats say follow-up talks are likely in the coming weeks, possibly involving European and Turkish intermediaries who have hosted previous rounds of indirect contact between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
segments.tr: Los diplomáticos dicen que es probable que haya conversaciones de seguimiento en las próximas semanas, posiblemente involucrando a intermediarios europeos y turcos que han albergado rondas previas de contacto indirecto entre las delegaciones rusa y ucraniana.

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: Hasta que la cuestión del Donbás se aborde frontalmente —a través de alguna fórmula que ambos gobiernos puedan presentar como defendible en casa— los funcionarios y analistas coinciden ampliamente en que incluso los momentos diplomáticos de alto perfil como el de Ankara probablemente generarán titulares sin producir el tipo de marco de alto el fuego duradero que ha eludido a los negociadores durante todo el año.

segments.src: ## The Sticking Point Hasn't Changed
segments.tr: ## نقطة الخلاف لم تتغير

segments.src: Kyiv has just as consistently rejected that demand, arguing that surrendering unoccupied, fortified territory — including cities Ukrainian forces have defended for years — would be both a constitutional and strategic red line.
segments.tr: وقد رفضت كييف هذا المطلب بنفس القدر من الثبات، معتبرة أن تسليم أراضٍ محصنة وغير محتلة - بما في ذلك مدن دافعت عنها القوات الأوكرانية لسنوات - سيكون خطاً أحمر دستورياً واستراتيجياً.

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: يقول المحللون الذين يتابعون المحادثات إن هذا هو خط الصدع الذي تسبب في فشل كل إطار عمل لوقف إطلاق النار تقريباً تم طرحه في 2026، من المقترحات التي توسطت فيها أوروبا إلى القنوات غير الرسمية التي شارك فيها وسطاء من الخليج.

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، فإن الضربات بعيدة المدى، مهما كانت دراماتيكية، لم تغير هذه المعادلة الأساسية.

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: بدت تعليقات ترامب في أنقرة وكأنها تؤيد تلك الحملة كأداة مساومة مشروعة بدلاً من كونها تصعيداً يجب تثبيطه - وهو خروج ملحوظ عن رسائل البيت الأبيض السابقة التي حثت على ضبط النفس في الضربات في عمق الأراضي الروسية.

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: لكن المسؤولين من الجانبين الأوكراني والروسي يحذرون من المبالغة في تفسير هذا التحول.

segments.tr: وقد قللت وسائل الإعلام الرسمية الروسية والمسؤولون من شأن اجتماع القمة، واصفين الضربات بأنها هجمات تقوي العزيمة المحلية بدلاً من إضعاف المواقف التفاوضية.

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.
segments.tr: وأكد المتحدثون باسم الكرملين أن القضايا الإقليمية هي "نقاط بداية غير قابلة للتفاوض"، وليست عروضاً افتتاحية تخضع لزخم ساحة المعركة.

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.
segments.tr: وفي الوقت نفسه، رحب المسؤولون الأوكرانيون بدعم ترامب البلاغي ولكنهم كانوا حذرين من المبالغة في تقدير ما يعنيه ذلك من الناحية العملية.

segments.src: Kyiv continues to seek firmer security guarantees — potential NATO-adjacent commitments or bilateral defense pacts — as a condition for any territorial compromise, a demand that has so far found no consensus among allies either.
segments.tr: تستمر كييف في السعي للحصول على ضمانات أمنية أكثر حزماً - التزامات محتملة مرتبطة بالناتو أو اتفاقيات دفاع ثنائية - كشرط لأي تسوية إقليمية، وهو مطلب لم يجد حتى الآن أي إجماع بين الحلفاء أيضاً.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## ماذا سيحدث بعد ذلك

segments.src: For now, the Ankara meeting appears to function more as a signal of alignment between Washington and Kyiv than as the start of a new negotiating track.
segments.tr: في الوقت الحالي، يبدو أن اجتماع أنقرة يعمل كإشارة على التوافق بين واشنطن وكييف أكثر من كونه بداية لمسار تفاوضي جديد.

segments.src: Diplomats say follow-up talks are likely in the coming weeks, possibly involving European and Turkish intermediaries who have hosted previous rounds of indirect contact between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
segments.tr: يقول الدبلوماسيون إن المحادثات المتابعة من المرجح أن تتم في الأسابيع المقبلة، وربما تشمل وسطاء أوروبيين وأتراك استضافوا جولات سابقة من الاتصال غير المباشر بين الوفود الروسية والأوكرانية.

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: وحتى يتم التعامل مع مسألة دونباس بشكل مباشر - من خلال صيغة يمكن للحكومتين تقديمها على أنها قابلة للدفاع عنها محلياً - يتفق المسؤولون والمحللون بشكل عام على أن حتى اللحظات الدبلوماسية رفيعة المستوى مثل تلك التي حدثت في أنقرة من المرجح أن تثير العناوين الرئيسية دون إنتاج نوع من إطار عمل وقف إطلاق النار الدائم الذي استعصى على المفاوضين طوال العام.

fr.title: Frappes profondes, discussions superficielles : pourquoi la rencontre de Trump et Zelensky à Ankara n'a pas fait bouger Moscou

segments.src: ## A Symbolic Handshake, Not a Breakthrough
segments.tr: ## Une poignée de main symbolique, pas une percée

segments.src: On the sidelines of the latest NATO summit in Ankara, President Donald Trump sat down with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky for a meeting that generated headlines but, according to officials briefed on the talks, little in the way of new terms.
segments.tr: En marge du dernier sommet de l'OTAN à Ankara, le président Donald Trump s'est entretenu avec le président ukrainien Volodymyr Zelensky lors d'une réunion qui a fait les gros titres, mais qui, selon des responsables informés des discussions, n'a guère apporté de nouveaux termes.

segments.src: Trump reportedly framed Ukraine's long-range strikes deep into Russian territory as a source of genuine battlefield leverage, suggesting that pressure on Russian infrastructure and logistics could eventually push Moscow toward the negotiating table on terms more favorable to Kyiv.
segments.tr: Trump aurait présenté les frappes à longue portée de l'Ukraine profondément dans le territoire russe comme une source de levier réel sur le champ de bataille, suggérant que la pression sur les infrastructures et la logistique russes pourrait éventuellement pousser Moscou vers la table des négociations selon des termes plus favorables à Kyiv.

segments.src: It was a notable shift in tone from a president who has spent much of the past year urging both sides toward a rapid ceasefire.
segments.tr: Il s'agissait d'un changement de ton notable de la part d'un président qui a passé une grande partie de l'année dernière à presser les deux parties vers un cessez-le-feu rapide.

segments.src: Yet according to diplomats familiar with the discussions, the meeting produced encouragement rather than a concrete framework — and the core dispute that has sunk every previous attempt at a truce remains untouched.
segments.tr: Pourtant, selon des diplomates familiers avec les discussions, la réunion a produit des encouragements plutôt qu'un cadre concret — et le différend central qui a fait échouer chaque tentative précédente de trêve reste intact.

segments.src: ## The Sticking Point Hasn't Changed
segments.tr: ## Le point de blocage n'a pas changé

segments.src: That dispute is the status of the Donbas.
segments.tr: Ce différend concerne le statut du Donbass.

segments.src: Russian negotiators have consistently signaled that any lasting settlement requires Ukraine to formally cede the remaining Ukrainian-held portions of Donetsk and Luhansk, territory Moscow already claims as annexed but does not fully control militarily.
segments.tr: Les négociateurs russes ont systématiquement signalé que tout règlement durable nécessite que l'Ukraine cède formellement les parties restantes du Donets et du Louhansk détenues par l'Ukraine, territoires que Moscou revendique déjà comme annexés mais qu'elle ne contrôle pas pleinement militairement.

segments.src: Kyiv has just as consistently rejected that demand, arguing that surrendering unoccupied, fortified territory — including cities Ukrainian forces have defended for years — would be both a constitutional and strategic red line.
segments.tr: Kyiv a tout aussi systématiquement rejeté cette exigence, arguant que la reddition de territoires fortifiés et non occupés — y compris des villes que les forces ukrainiennes défendent depuis des années — constituerait une ligne rouge tant constitutionnelle que stratégique.

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: Les analystes qui suivent les discussions affirment que c'est la ligne de fracture qui a fait capoter presque tous les cadres de cessez-le-feu proposés en 2026, des propositions négociées par l'Europe aux canaux informels impliquant des médiateurs du Golfe.

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.
segments.tr: Les frappes à longue portée, aussi spectaculaires soient-elles, n'ont pas modifié cette équation de base.

segments.src: "Battlefield pressure can change the pace of talks," one Europe-based security analyst said.
segments.tr: "La pression sur le champ de bataille peut changer le rythme des discussions", a déclaré un analyste de la sécurité basé en Europe.

segments.src: "It hasn't changed the substance of what each side says it needs to walk away with."
segments.tr: "Elle n'a pas changé la substance de ce que chaque partie dit avoir besoin d'obtenir pour conclure l'accord."

segments.src: ## Why Strikes Alone Don't Translate Into Leverage
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les frappes seules ne se traduisent pas en levier

segments.src: Ukraine's expanded use of long-range drones and missiles against refineries, depots, and logistics hubs inside Russia has undeniably raised costs for Moscow and disrupted parts of its energy sector.
segments.tr: L'utilisation élargie par l'Ukraine de drones et de missiles à longue portée contre des raffineries, des dépôts et des centres logistiques à l'intérieur de la Russie a indéniablement augmenté les coûts pour Moscou et perturbé certaines parties de son secteur énergétique.

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: Les commentaires de Trump à Ankara semblaient cautionner cette campagne comme un outil de négociation légitime plutôt que comme une escalade à décourager — un écart notable par rapport aux messages précédents de la Maison Blanche qui appelaient à la retenue concernant les frappes profondes dans le territoire russe.

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: Mais des responsables des deux côtés, ukrainien et russe, mettent en garde contre une interprétation excessive de ce changement.

segments.src: Russian state media and officials have downplayed the summit meeting, characterizing the strikes as attacks that stiffen domestic resolve rather than weaken negotiating positions.
segments.tr: Les médias d'État russes et les responsables ont minimisé la réunion du sommet, caractérisant les frappes comme des attaques qui renforcent la détermination nationale plutôt que d'affaiblir les positions de négociation.

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.
segments.tr: Les porte-parole du Kremlin ont réitéré que les questions territoriales sont des "points de départ non négociables", et non des offres d'ouverture soumises au momentum du champ de bataille.

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.
segments.tr: Pendant ce temps, les responsables ukrainiens ont accueilli le soutien rhétorique de Trump, mais ont été prudents de ne pas surestimer ce que cela signifie en pratique.

segments.src: Kyiv continues to seek firmer security guarantees — potential NATO-adjacent commitments or bilateral defense pacts — as a condition for any territorial compromise, a demand that has so far found no consensus among allies either.
segments.tr: Kyiv continue de chercher des garanties de sécurité plus fermes — d'éventuels engagements proches de l'OTAN ou des pactes de défense bilatéraux — comme condition à tout compromis territorial, une exigence qui n'a jusqu'à présent trouvé aucun consensus parmi les alliés.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Quelle est la suite

segments.src: For now, the Ankara meeting appears to function more as a signal of alignment between Washington and Kyiv than as the start of a new negotiating track.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, la réunion d'Ankara semble fonctionner davantage comme un signal d'alignement entre Washington et Kyiv que comme le début d'une nouvelle voie de négociation.

segments.src: Diplomats say follow-up talks are likely in the coming weeks, possibly involving European and Turkish intermediaries who have hosted previous rounds of indirect contact between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
segments.tr: Les diplomates disent que des discussions de suivi sont probables dans les semaines à venir, impliquant possiblement des intermédiaires européens et turcs qui ont accueilli des rounds précédents de contacts indirects entre les délégations russes et ukrainiennes.

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: Tant que la question du Donbass ne sera pas abordée de front — via une formule que les deux gouvernements peuvent présenter comme défendable chez eux — les responsables et les analystes s'accordent largement pour dire que même des moments diplomatiques de haut profil comme celui d'Ankara sont susceptibles de générer des gros titres sans produire le type de cadre de cessez-le-feu durable qui a échappé aux négociateurs tout au long de l'année.

in.title: Serangan Jauh, Pembicaraan Dangkal: Mengapa Pertemuan Trump dengan Zelensky di Ankara Tidak Menggerakkan Moskow

segments.src: ## A Symbolic Handshake, Not a Breakthrough

segments.src: On the sidelines of the latest NATO summit in Ankara, President Donald Trump sat down with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky for a meeting that generated headlines but, according to officials briefed on the talks, little in the way of new terms.
segments.tr: Di sela-sela KTT NATO terbaru di Ankara, Presiden Donald Trump bertemu dengan Presiden Ukraina Volodymyr Zelensky dalam sebuah pertemuan yang menghasilkan berita utama tetapi, menurut para pejabat yang mendapat pengarahan tentang pembicaraan tersebut, memberikan sedikit ketentuan baru.

segments.src: Trump reportedly framed Ukraine's long-range strikes deep into Russian territory as a source of genuine battlefield leverage, suggesting that pressure on Russian infrastructure and logistics could eventually push Moscow toward the negotiating table on terms more favorable to Kyiv.
segments.tr: Trump dilaporkan membingkai serangan jarak jauh Ukraina jauh ke dalam wilayah Rusia sebagai sumber daya tawar medan perang yang nyata, menunjukkan bahwa tekanan pada infrastruktur dan logistik Rusia pada akhirnya dapat mendorong Moskow ke meja perundingan dengan persyaratan yang lebih menguntungkan bagi Kyiv.

segments.src: It was a notable shift in tone from a president who has spent much of the past year urging both sides toward a rapid ceasefire.
segments.tr: Ini merupakan perubahan nada yang mencolok dari seorang presiden yang telah menghabiskan sebagian besar tahun lalu mendesak kedua belah pihak untuk segera melakukan gencatan senjata.

segments.src: Yet according to diplomats familiar with the discussions, the meeting produced encouragement rather than a concrete framework — and the core dispute that has sunk every previous attempt at a truce remains untouched.
segments.tr: Namun menurut para diplomat yang mengetahui diskusi tersebut, pertemuan itu menghasilkan dorongan semangat daripada kerangka kerja konkret — dan perselisihan inti yang telah menggagalkan setiap upaya gencatan senjata sebelumnya tetap tidak tersentuh.

segments.src: ## The Sticking Point Hasn't Changed
segments.tr: ## Titik Buntu Tidak Berubah

segments.src: That dispute is the status of the Donbas.
segments.tr: Perselisihan tersebut adalah status Donbas.

segments.src: Russian negotiators have consistently signaled that any lasting settlement requires Ukraine to formally cede the remaining Ukrainian-held portions of Donetsk and Luhansk, territory Moscow already claims as annexed but does not fully control militarily.
segments.tr: Negosiator Rusia secara konsisten memberi sinyal bahwa penyelesaian yang langgeng mengharuskan Ukraina untuk secara resmi menyerahkan bagian-bagian Donetsk dan Luhansk yang masih dikuasai Ukraina, wilayah yang sudah diklaim Moskow sebagai aneksasi tetapi tidak dikendalikan sepenuhnya secara militer.

segments.src: Kyiv has just as consistently rejected that demand, arguing that surrendering unoccupied, fortified territory — including cities Ukrainian forces have defended for years — would be both a constitutional and strategic red line.
segments.tr: Kyiv secara konsisten menolak tuntutan tersebut, dengan argumen bahwa menyerahkan wilayah berbenteng yang tidak diduduki — termasuk kota-kota yang telah dipertahankan pasukan Ukraina selama bertahun-tahun — akan menjadi garis merah konstitusional sekaligus strategis.

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: Analis yang memantau pembicaraan tersebut mengatakan bahwa inilah garis patahan yang telah menggagalkan hampir setiap kerangka gencatan senjata yang diajukan pada tahun 2026, mulai dari proposal yang diperantarai Eropa hingga saluran informal yang melibatkan mediator Teluk.

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.
segments.tr: Serangan jarak jauh, betapapun dramatisnya, tidak mengubah persamaan dasar tersebut.

segments.src: "Battlefield pressure can change the pace of talks," one Europe-based security analyst said.
segments.tr: "Tekanan medan perang dapat mengubah kecepatan pembicaraan," kata seorang analis keamanan yang berbasis di Eropa.

segments.src: "It hasn't changed the substance of what each side says it needs to walk away with."
segments.tr: "Namun itu tidak mengubah substansi dari apa yang dikatakan setiap pihak sebagai hal yang harus mereka dapatkan sebelum mengakhiri konflik."

segments.src: ## Why Strikes Alone Don't Translate Into Leverage
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Serangan Saja Tidak Berarti Daya Tawar

segments.src: Ukraine's expanded use of long-range drones and missiles against refineries, depots, and logistics hubs inside Russia has undeniably raised costs for Moscow and disrupted parts of its energy sector.
segments.tr: Perluasan penggunaan drone dan rudal jarak jauh Ukraina terhadap kilang, depot, dan pusat logistik di dalam Rusia tidak dapat dipungkiri telah meningkatkan biaya bagi Moskow dan mengganggu sebagian sektor energinya.

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: Komentar Trump di Ankara tampak mendukung kampanye tersebut sebagai alat tawar-menawar yang sah daripada eskalasi yang harus dicegah — sebuah penyimpangan nyata dari pesan Gedung Putih sebelumnya yang mendesak pengendalian serangan jauh ke dalam wilayah Rusia.

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: Namun pejabat dari pihak Ukraina maupun Rusia memperingatkan agar tidak terlalu menginterpretasikan perubahan tersebut.

segments.src: Russian state media and officials have downplayed the summit meeting, characterizing the strikes as attacks that stiffen domestic resolve rather than weaken negotiating positions.
segments.tr: Media pemerintah Rusia dan para pejabat meremehkan pertemuan KTT tersebut, mengarakterisasi serangan-serangan itu sebagai serangan yang justru memperkuat tekad domestik daripada melemahkan posisi perundingan.

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.
segments.tr: Juru bicara Kremlin menegaskan kembali bahwa pertanyaan teritorial adalah "titik awal yang tidak dapat dinegosiasikan," bukan tawaran pembuka yang bergantung pada momentum medan perang.

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.
segments.tr: Sementara itu, pejabat Ukraina menyambut dukungan retoris Trump tetapi berhati-hati untuk tidak melebih-lebihkan apa artinya dalam praktiknya.

segments.src: Kyiv continues to seek firmer security guarantees — potential NATO-adjacent commitments or bilateral defense pacts — as a condition for any territorial compromise, a demand that has so far found no consensus among allies either.
segments.tr: Kyiv terus mencari jaminan keamanan yang lebih kokoh — potensi komitmen yang berdekatan dengan NATO atau pakta pertahanan bilateral — sebagai syarat untuk kompromi teritorial apa pun, sebuah tuntutan yang sejauh ini juga tidak menemukan konsensus di antara para sekutu.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Terjadi Selanjutnya

segments.src: For now, the Ankara meeting appears to function more as a signal of alignment between Washington and Kyiv than as the start of a new negotiating track.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, pertemuan Ankara tampak lebih berfungsi sebagai sinyal penyelarasan antara Washington dan Kyiv daripada sebagai awal dari jalur negosiasi baru.

segments.src: Diplomats say follow-up talks are likely in the coming weeks, possibly involving European and Turkish intermediaries who have hosted previous rounds of indirect contact between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
segments.tr: Para diplomat mengatakan pembicaraan lanjutan kemungkinan terjadi dalam beberapa minggu mendatang, kemungkinan melibatkan perantara Eropa dan Turki yang telah menjadi tuan rumah putaran kontak tidak langsung sebelumnya antara delegasi Rusia dan Ukraina.

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: Hingga masalah Donbas ditangani secara langsung — melalui beberapa formula yang dapat dipresentasikan oleh kedua pemerintah sebagai hal yang dapat dipertahankan di dalam negeri — para pejabat dan analis secara luas setuju bahwa bahkan momen diplomatik profil tinggi seperti yang terjadi di Ankara kemungkinan hanya akan menghasilkan berita utama tanpa menghasilkan kerangka gencatan senjata tahan lama yang telah luput dari para negosiator sepanjang tahun.

ja.title: 深層打撃と浅薄な会談：トランプとゼレンスキーのアンカラ会談がモスクワを動かせない理由

segments.src: ## A Symbolic Handshake, Not a Breakthrough
segments.tr: ## 突破口ではなく、象徴的な握手

segments.src: On the sidelines of the latest NATO summit in Ankara, President Donald Trump sat down with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky for a meeting that generated headlines but, according to officials briefed on the talks, little in the way of new terms.
segments.tr: アンカラで開催された最新のNATOサミットの合間に、ドナルド・トランプ大統領はウクライナのヴォロディミル・ゼレンスキー大統領と会談しました。この会談は大きく報じられたものの、会談のブリーフィングを受けた高官らによれば、新たな条件の面での進展はほとんどありませんでした。

segments.src: Trump reportedly framed Ukraine's long-range strikes deep into Russian territory as a source of genuine battlefield leverage, suggesting that pressure on Russian infrastructure and logistics could eventually push Moscow toward the negotiating table on terms more favorable to Kyiv.
segments.tr: トランプ氏は、ロシア領土深くへのウクライナの遠距離打撃を戦場における真のテコ（有利な要因）として位置付け、ロシアのインフラや物流への圧力が、最終的にはキエフにとってより有利な条件でモスクワを交渉の席に着かせる可能性があると示唆したと報じられています。

segments.src: It was a notable shift in tone from a president who has spent much of the past year urging both sides toward a rapid ceasefire.
segments.tr: これは、過去1年の大半を双方に迅速な停戦を促すことに費やしてきた大統領にとって、トーンの注目すべき変化でした。

segments.src: Yet according to diplomats familiar with the discussions, the meeting produced encouragement rather than a concrete framework — and the core dispute that has sunk every previous attempt at a truce remains untouched.
segments.tr: しかし、議論に詳しい外交官らによると、会談は具体的なフレームワークではなく励ましを生み出したにとどまり、これまでのすべての休戦の試みを頓挫させてきた核心的な対立点には手が付けられないままとなっています。

segments.src: ## The Sticking Point Hasn't Changed
segments.tr: ## 変わらない争点

segments.src: That dispute is the status of the Donbas.
segments.tr: その対立点とはドンバスの地位です。

segments.src: Russian negotiators have consistently signaled that any lasting settlement requires Ukraine to formally cede the remaining Ukrainian-held portions of Donetsk and Luhansk, territory Moscow already claims as annexed but does not fully control militarily.
segments.tr: ロシア側の交渉担当者は、ウクライナがドネツク州とルハンスク州のウクライナ保持地域を正式に割譲することが持続的な解決の必須条件であると一貫して示唆してきました。この地域はモスクワがすでに併合を主張しているものの、軍事的に完全に支配しているわけではありません。

segments.src: Kyiv has just as consistently rejected that demand, arguing that surrendering unoccupied, fortified territory — including cities Ukrainian forces have defended for years — would be both a constitutional and strategic red line.
segments.tr: キエフも同様に一貫してその要求を拒否しており、ウクライナ軍が何年も防衛してきた都市を含む、非占領の要塞化された地域を手放すことは、憲法上および戦略上のレッドライン（越えてはならない一線）であると主張しています。

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: 会談を追跡しているアナリストらは、これこそが欧州が仲介した提案から湾岸諸国の仲介者が関与する非公式ルートに至るまで、2026年に提示されたほぼすべての停戦フレームワークを頓挫させてきた断層線であると述べています。

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.
segments.tr: 遠距離打撃は、どれほど劇的であっても、その基本的な構図を変えていません。

segments.src: "Battlefield pressure can change the pace of talks," one Europe-based security analyst said.
segments.tr: 「戦場での圧力は交渉のペースを変えることができます」と、欧州を拠点とするある安全保障アナリストは語りました。

segments.src: "It hasn't changed the substance of what each side says it needs to walk away with."
segments.tr: 「しかし、各陣営が交渉を締めくくるために必要だと主張している内容の本質を変えるには至っていません。」

segments.src: ## Why Strikes Alone Don't Translate Into Leverage
segments.tr: ## 打撃だけではテコにならない理由

segments.src: Ukraine's expanded use of long-range drones and missiles against refineries, depots, and logistics hubs inside Russia has undeniably raised costs for Moscow and disrupted parts of its energy sector.
segments.tr: ロシア国内の製油所、デポ、物流ハブに対するウクライナの長距離ドローンやミサイルの使用拡大は、間違いなくモスクワのコストを引き上げ、エネルギーセクターの一部を混乱させました。

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: アンカラでのトランプ氏の発言は、この打撃キャンペーンを制止すべき拡大行為ではなく、正当な交渉のツールとして承認するように見えました。これは、ロシア領土深くへの打撃に自制を求めていた以前のホワイトハウスの発信からの注目すべき転換です。

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: しかし、ウクライナとロシアの双方の高官は、この変化を過大評価しないよう警告しています。

segments.src: Russian state media and officials have downplayed the summit meeting, characterizing the strikes as attacks that stiffen domestic resolve rather than weaken negotiating positions.
segments.tr: ロシアの国営メディアや高官らは首脳会談を過小評価しており、これらの打撃は交渉立場を弱めるものではなく、国内の団結を強める攻撃であると描写しています。

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.
segments.tr: クレムリンの報道官らは、領土問題は戦場の勢いに左右される交渉の出発点ではなく、「交渉不可能な前提条件」であると改めて強調しています。

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.
segments.tr: 一方、ウクライナの高官らはトランプ氏の修辞的な支援を歓迎しつつも、それが実際的に何を意味するのかについて過大評価しないよう慎重な姿勢を見せています。

segments.src: Kyiv continues to seek firmer security guarantees — potential NATO-adjacent commitments or bilateral defense pacts — as a condition for any territorial compromise, a demand that has so far found no consensus among allies either.
segments.tr: キエフは、いかなる領土的妥協の条件としても、より強固な安全保障の保証（NATOに準ずるコミットメントや二国間防衛条約など）を求め続けていますが、この要求についても同盟国の間でまだコンセンサスが得られていません。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 次に何が起こるか

segments.src: For now, the Ankara meeting appears to function more as a signal of alignment between Washington and Kyiv than as the start of a new negotiating track.
segments.tr: 今のところ、アンカラ会談は新たな交渉軌道の始まりというよりも、ワシントンとキエフの間の結束を示すシグナルとして機能しているように見えます。

segments.src: Diplomats say follow-up talks are likely in the coming weeks, possibly involving European and Turkish intermediaries who have hosted previous rounds of indirect contact between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
segments.tr: 外交官らによると、数週間以内に追都会談が行われる可能性が高く、ロシアとウクライナの代表団の間の間接的な接触を過去に主催した欧州やトルコの仲介者が関与する可能性があるとのことです。

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: ドンバス問題に正面から取り組まない限り — 両国政府が自国で防衛可能として提示できる何らかの公式を通じて — アンカラでのような注目度の高い外交的瞬間でさえ、年間を通じて交渉者をかわしてきたような耐久性のある停戦フレームワークを生み出すことなく、ニュースの見出しを生み出すだけで終わる可能性が高いという点で、高官やアナリストの見解は概ね一致しています。

de.title: Tiefe Schläge, oberflächliche Gespräche: Warum Trumps Treffen mit Selenskyj in Ankara Moskau nicht bewegt hat

segments.src: ## A Symbolic Handshake, Not a Breakthrough
segments.tr: ## Ein symbolischer Händedruck, kein Durchbruch

segments.src: On the sidelines of the latest NATO summit in Ankara, President Donald Trump sat down with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky for a meeting that generated headlines but, according to officials briefed on the talks, little in the way of new terms.
segments.tr: Am Rande des jüngsten NATO-Gipfels in Ankara traf sich Präsident Donald Trump mit dem ukrainischen Präsidenten Wolodymyr Selenskyj zu einem Gespräch, das zwar für Schlagzeilen sorgte, aber laut Beamten, die über die Gespräche informiert wurden, kaum neue Bedingungen hervorbrachte.

segments.src: Trump reportedly framed Ukraine's long-range strikes deep into Russian territory as a source of genuine battlefield leverage, suggesting that pressure on Russian infrastructure and logistics could eventually push Moscow toward the negotiating table on terms more favorable to Kyiv.
segments.tr: Trump stellte Berichten zufolge die Weitbereichsangriffe der Ukraine tief in russisches Territorium als Quelle echter Druckmittel auf dem Schlachtfeld dar und deutete an, dass der Druck auf die russische Infrastruktur und Logistik Moskau schließlich zu Verhandlungen zu Bedingungen bewegen könnte, die für Kyjiw günstiger sind.

segments.src: It was a notable shift in tone from a president who has spent much of the past year urging both sides toward a rapid ceasefire.
segments.tr: Dies war ein bemerkenswerter Tonwechsel eines Präsidenten, der den Großteil des vergangenen Jahres damit verbracht hat, beide Seiten zu einem raschen Waffenstillstand zu drängen.

segments.src: Yet according to diplomats familiar with the discussions, the meeting produced encouragement rather than a concrete framework — and the core dispute that has sunk every previous attempt at a truce remains untouched.
segments.tr: Doch laut Diplomaten, die mit den Diskussionen vertraut sind, führte das Treffen eher zu Ermutigung als zu einem konkreten Rahmen — und der Kernstreit, der jeden früheren Versuch eines Waffenstillstands zunichte gemacht hat, bleibt unberührt.

segments.src: ## The Sticking Point Hasn't Changed
segments.tr: ## Der Knackpunkt hat sich nicht geändert

segments.src: That dispute is the status of the Donbas.
segments.tr: Dieser Streit betrifft den Status des Donbas.

segments.src: Russian negotiators have consistently signaled that any lasting settlement requires Ukraine to formally cede the remaining Ukrainian-held portions of Donetsk and Luhansk, territory Moscow already claims as annexed but does not fully control militarily.
segments.tr: Russische Unterhändler haben konsequent signalisiert, dass jede dauerhafte Regelung erfordert, dass die Ukraine die verbleibenden von der Ukraine gehaltenen Teile von Donezk und Luhansk offiziell abtritt — Gebiete, die Moskau bereits als annektiert beansprucht, aber militärisch nicht vollständig kontrolliert.

segments.src: Kyiv has just as consistently rejected that demand, arguing that surrendering unoccupied, fortified territory — including cities Ukrainian forces have defended for years — would be both a constitutional and strategic red line.
segments.tr: Kyjiw hat diese Forderung ebenso konsequent zurückgewiesen mit dem Argument, dass die Aufgabe unbesetzter, befestigter Gebiete — einschließlich von Städten, die die ukrainischen Streitkräfte seit Jahren verteidigen — sowohl eine verfassungsrechtliche als auch eine strategische rote Linie wäre.

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: Analysten, die die Gespräche verfolgen, sagen, dies sei die Bruchlinie, die nahezu jeden im Jahr 2026 ins Gespräch gebrachten Waffenstillstandsrahmen zum Kentern gebracht hat, von europäisch vermittelten Vorschlägen bis hin zu informellen Kanälen mit Vermittlern aus den Golfstaaten.

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.
segments.tr: Weitbereichsangriffe, so dramatisch sie auch sein mögen, haben an dieser Grundgleichung nichts geändert.

segments.src: "Battlefield pressure can change the pace of talks," one Europe-based security analyst said.
segments.tr: „Druck auf dem Schlachtfeld kann das Tempo der Gespräche verändern“, sagte ein in Europa ansässiger Sicherheitsanalyst.

segments.src: "It hasn't changed the substance of what each side says it needs to walk away with."
segments.tr: „Es hat nichts an der Substanz dessen geändert, was jede Seite nach eigener Aussage benötigt, um das Gespräch erfolgreich zu beenden.“

segments.src: ## Why Strikes Alone Don't Translate Into Leverage
segments.tr: ## Warum Angriffe allein nicht in Druckmittel übersetzt werden können

segments.src: Ukraine's expanded use of long-range drones and missiles against refineries, depots, and logistics hubs inside Russia has undeniably raised costs for Moscow and disrupted parts of its energy sector.
segments.tr: Der erweiterte Einsatz von Langstreckendrohnen und -raketen durch die Ukraine gegen Raffinerien, Depotanlagen und Logistikdrehkreuze innerhalb Russlands hat unbestreitbar die Kosten für Moskau erhöht und Teile seines Energiesektors gestört.

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: Trumps Bemerkungen in Ankara schienen diese Kampagne als legitimes Verhandlungsinstrument und nicht als eine zu verhindernde Eskalation zu billigen — eine bemerkenswerte Abweichung von früheren Botschaften des Weißen Hauses, die zur Zurückhaltung bei Angriffen tief im russischen Gebiet gemahnt hatten.

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: Doch Beamte auf ukrainischer wie auf russischer Seite warnen davor, zu viel in diesen Wandel hineinzuinterpretieren.

segments.src: Russian state media and officials have downplayed the summit meeting, characterizing the strikes as attacks that stiffen domestic resolve rather than weaken negotiating positions.
segments.tr: Russische Staatsmedien und Beamte haben das Gipfeltreffen heruntergespielt und die Angriffe als Aktionen dargestellt, die die Verhandlungsstärkung im Inland eher festigen als schwächen.

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.

segments.tr: ## Was als Nächstes kommt

segments.tr: Diplomaten sagen, dass Folgetreffen in den kommenden Wochen wahrscheinlich sind, möglicherweise unter Einbeziehung europäischer und türkischer Vermittler, die bereits frühere Runden indirekter Kontakte zwischen russischen und ukrainischen Delegationen ausgerichtet haben.

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: Bis die Donbas-Frage direkt angegangen wird — durch eine Formel, die beide Regierungen im Inland als vertretbar darstellen können — herrscht unter Beamten und Analysten weitgehend Einigkeit darüber, dass selbst hochkarätige diplomatische Momente wie der in Ankara wahrscheinlich Schlagzeilen erzeugen werden, ohne die Art von dauerhaftem Waffenstillstandsrahmen hervorzubringen, der sich den Unterhändlern das ganze Jahr über entzogen hat.

vi.title: Đòn tấn công sâu, Cuộc đối thoại hời hợt: Tại sao cuộc gặp tại Ankara giữa Trump và Zelensky không làm Moscow lay chuyển

segments.src: ## A Symbolic Handshake, Not a Breakthrough
segments.tr: ## Một cái bắt tay mang tính biểu tượng, không phải một bước đột phá

segments.src: On the sidelines of the latest NATO summit in Ankara, President Donald Trump sat down with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky for a meeting that generated headlines but, according to officials briefed on the talks, little in the way of new terms.
segments.tr: Bên lề hội nghị thượng đỉnh NATO mới nhất tại Ankara, Tổng thống Donald Trump đã ngồi lại với Tổng thống Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky trong một cuộc gặp gỡ tạo ra nhiều tiêu đề báo chí nhưng, theo các quan chức được thông báo về cuộc hội đàm, lại mang lại rất ít điều khoản mới.

segments.src: Trump reportedly framed Ukraine's long-range strikes deep into Russian territory as a source of genuine battlefield leverage, suggesting that pressure on Russian infrastructure and logistics could eventually push Moscow toward the negotiating table on terms more favorable to Kyiv.
segments.tr: Trump được cho là đã định khung các cuộc tấn công tầm xa của Ukraine sâu vào lãnh thổ Nga như một nguồn đòn bẩy chiến trường thực sự, gợi ý rằng áp lực lên cơ sở hạ tầng và hậu cần của Nga cuối cùng có thể đẩy Moscow về phía bàn đàm phán với các điều khoản có lợi hơn cho Kyiv.

segments.src: It was a notable shift in tone from a president who has spent much of the past year urging both sides toward a rapid ceasefire.
segments.tr: Đó là một sự thay đổi đáng kể về tông giọng từ một vị tổng thống đã dành phần lớn năm qua để thúc giục cả hai bên tiến tới một lệnh ngừng bắn nhanh chóng.

segments.src: Yet according to diplomats familiar with the discussions, the meeting produced encouragement rather than a concrete framework — and the core dispute that has sunk every previous attempt at a truce remains untouched.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, theo các nhà ngoại giao quen thuộc với các cuộc thảo luận, cuộc gặp gỡ đã tạo ra sự khích lệ hơn là một khung làm việc cụ thể — và tranh chấp cốt lõi khiến mọi nỗ lực đình chiến trước đó thất bại vẫn chưa được giải quyết.

segments.src: ## The Sticking Point Hasn't Changed
segments.tr: ## Điểm nghẽn vẫn không thay đổi

segments.src: That dispute is the status of the Donbas.
segments.tr: Tranh chấp đó chính là tình trạng của vùng Donbas.

segments.src: Russian negotiators have consistently signaled that any lasting settlement requires Ukraine to formally cede the remaining Ukrainian-held portions of Donetsk and Luhansk, territory Moscow already claims as annexed but does not fully control militarily.
segments.tr: Các nhà đàm phán Nga liên tục ra tín hiệu rằng bất kỳ thỏa thuận lâu dài nào cũng yêu cầu Ukraine phải chính thức nhượng lại các phần còn lại của Donetsk và Luhansk do Ukraine nắm giữ, vùng lãnh thổ mà Moscow đã tuyên bố sáp nhập nhưng không kiểm soát hoàn toàn về mặt quân sự.

segments.src: Kyiv has just as consistently rejected that demand, arguing that surrendering unoccupied, fortified territory — including cities Ukrainian forces have defended for years — would be both a constitutional and strategic red line.
segments.tr: Kyiv cũng liên tục bác bỏ yêu cầu đó, lập luận rằng việc từ bỏ lãnh thổ kiên cố, chưa bị chiếm đóng — bao gồm các thành phố mà lực lượng Ukraine đã bảo vệ trong nhiều năm — sẽ là một lằn ranh đỏ cả về hiến pháp và chiến lược.

segments.src: Analysts who track the talks say this is the fault line that has capsized nearly every ceasefire framework floated in 2026, from European-brokered proposals to informal channels involving Gulf mediators.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích theo dõi các cuộc đàm phán cho biết đây là đường đứt gãy khiến gần như mọi khung ngừng bắn được đưa ra trong năm 2026 bị sụp đổ, từ các đề xuất do châu Âu môi giới đến các kênh không chính thức liên quan đến các nhà trung gian vùng Vịnh.

segments.src: Long-range strikes, however dramatic, have not altered that basic equation.
segments.tr: Các cuộc tấn công tầm xa, dù kịch tính đến đâu, cũng không làm thay đổi phương trình cơ bản đó.

segments.src: "Battlefield pressure can change the pace of talks," one Europe-based security analyst said.
segments.tr: "Áp lực chiến trường có thể thay đổi tốc độ của các cuộc đàm phán," một nhà phân tích an ninh tại châu Âu cho biết.

segments.src: "It hasn't changed the substance of what each side says it needs to walk away with."
segments.tr: "Nó không làm thay đổi bản chất của những gì mỗi bên nói rằng họ cần đạt được khi rời bàn đàm phán."

segments.src: ## Why Strikes Alone Don't Translate Into Leverage
segments.tr: ## Tại sao chỉ riêng các cuộc tấn công không chuyển hóa thành đòn bẩy

segments.src: Ukraine's expanded use of long-range drones and missiles against refineries, depots, and logistics hubs inside Russia has undeniably raised costs for Moscow and disrupted parts of its energy sector.
segments.tr: Việc Ukraine mở rộng sử dụng máy bay không người lái và tên lửa tầm xa chống lại các nhà máy lọc dầu, kho bãi và trung tâm hậu cần bên trong nước Nga không thể phủ nhận đã làm tăng chi phí cho Moscow và gây gián đoạn một phần lĩnh vực năng lượng của họ.

segments.src: Trump's comments in Ankara appeared to endorse that campaign as a legitimate bargaining tool rather than an escalation to be discouraged — a notable departure from earlier White House messaging that had urged restraint on strikes deep inside Russian territory.
segments.tr: Các bình luận của Trump tại Ankara dường như tán thành chiến dịch đó như một công cụ mặc cả hợp pháp thay vì là một sự leo thang cần bị ngăn chặn — một sự thay đổi đáng kể so với các thông điệp trước đây của Nhà Trắng thúc giục sự kiềm chế trong các cuộc tấn công sâu vào lãnh thổ Nga.

segments.src: But officials on both the Ukrainian and Russian sides caution against reading too much into the shift.
segments.tr: Nhưng các quan chức của cả phía Ukraine và Nga đều cảnh báo không nên suy diễn quá nhiều về sự thay đổi này.

segments.src: Russian state media and officials have downplayed the summit meeting, characterizing the strikes as attacks that stiffen domestic resolve rather than weaken negotiating positions.
segments.tr: Truyền thông nhà nước Nga và các quan chức đã hạ thấp tầm quan trọng của cuộc gặp thượng đỉnh, mô tả các cuộc tấn công là những cuộc tấn công làm cứng rắn thêm quyết tâm trong nước thay vì làm yếu đi vị thế đàm phán.

segments.src: Kremlin spokespeople have reiterated that territorial questions are "non-negotiable starting points," not opening bids subject to battlefield momentum.
segments.tr: Các phát ngôn viên của Điện Kremlin đã nhắc lại rằng các vấn đề về lãnh thổ là "điểm khởi đầu không thể thương lượng", không phải là những đề nghị mở đầu tùy thuộc vào đà tiến của chiến trường.

segments.src: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials have welcomed Trump's rhetorical support but have been careful not to overstate what it means in practice.
segments.tr: Trong khi đó, các quan chức Ukraine đã hoan nghênh sự ủng hộ về mặt ngôn từ của Trump nhưng cẩn thận không nói quá về ý nghĩa thực tế của nó.

segments.src: Kyiv continues to seek firmer security guarantees — potential NATO-adjacent commitments or bilateral defense pacts — as a condition for any territorial compromise, a demand that has so far found no consensus among allies either.
segments.tr: Kyiv tiếp tục tìm kiếm các đảm bảo an ninh vững chắc hơn — các cam kết tương tự NATO hoặc các hiệp ước phòng thủ song phương — như một điều kiện cho bất kỳ sự thỏa hiệp về lãnh thổ nào, một yêu cầu mà cho đến nay vẫn chưa tìm thấy sự đồng thuận giữa các đồng minh.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Điều gì sẽ diễn ra tiếp theo

segments.src: For now, the Ankara meeting appears to function more as a signal of alignment between Washington and Kyiv than as the start of a new negotiating track.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, cuộc gặp tại Ankara dường như đóng vai trò như một tín hiệu về sự liên kết giữa Washington và Kyiv hơn là khởi đầu của một lộ trình đàm phán mới.

segments.src: Diplomats say follow-up talks are likely in the coming weeks, possibly involving European and Turkish intermediaries who have hosted previous rounds of indirect contact between Russian and Ukrainian delegations.
segments.tr: Các nhà ngoại giao cho biết các cuộc đàm phán tiếp theo có khả năng diễn ra trong những tuần tới, có thể bao gồm các trung gian châu Âu và Thổ Nhĩ Kỳ, những người đã tổ chức các vòng tiếp xúc gián tiếp trước đó giữa các phái đoàn Nga và Ukraine.

segments.src: Until the Donbas question is addressed head-on — through some formula both governments can present as defensible at home — officials and analysts broadly agree that even high-profile diplomatic moments like the one in Ankara are likely to generate headlines without producing the kind of durable ceasefire framework that has eluded negotiators throughout the year.
segments.tr: Cho đến khi vấn đề Donbas được giải quyết trực diện — thông qua một công thức mà cả hai chính phủ có thể trình bày là có thể bảo vệ được ở trong nước — các quan chức và nhà phân tích nhìn chung đồng ý rằng ngay cả những khoảnh khắc ngoại giao cao cấp như cuộc gặp tại Ankara cũng có khả năng chỉ tạo ra các tiêu đề báo chí mà không tạo ra được khung ngừng bắn bền vững mà các nhà đàm phán đã tìm kiếm trong suốt năm qua.
